Background of UPSC Topper Monika Srivastava

Monika Srivastava belongs to Aurangabad district of Bihar . She completed her schooling from DAV Public School, Aurangabad , where she performed strongly in academics and secured distinction during her school years.

She later completed her B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati . Her technical background helped develop analytical thinking and structured problem-solving ability, which supported her preparation for the Civil Services Examination.

Before achieving success in UPSC, she also gained professional experience as a Software Engineer at PayPal India and later served as Assistant Commissioner of State Tax in the Government of Bihar. She was subsequently associated with the Indian Railway Management Service (Traffic) before securing a top rank in UPSC CSE 2025.

UPSC Journey and Attempts

Monika Srivastava’s UPSC journey reflects perseverance, strategic improvement, and long-term commitment to public service. She had earlier cleared the Civil Services Examination with All India Rank (AIR) 455 , through which she was selected for the Indian Railway Traffic Service (IRTS) and began her training in the railway services.

Determined to achieve a higher rank, she continued her preparation while in service and appeared for the examination again. Her sustained effort culminated in UPSC CSE 2025 , where she secured AIR 16 in her sixth attempt , marking a remarkable improvement in rank.
Her journey highlights the value of persistence, disciplined revision, and continuous refinement of preparation strategy across multiple attempts.
Optional Subject of Monika Srivastava

For the UPSC Civil Services Mains Examination, Monika Srivastava chose Economics as her optional subject. Her optional choice complemented her analytical background and supported structured answer writing in the Mains examination.
